newsitem.title: UK: Danzas plans Manchester airport expansion.
newsitem.headline: Danzas plans Manchester airport expansion.

text.p: Danzas (UK) Ltd said it will relocate its UK intercontinental division headquarters to Manchester airport from London-Heathrow.

The company, part of the Swiss-based Danzas group, will locate to a temporary facility within the next couple of months and then expects to move a new site in Manchester airport's expanded cargo site in early 1998, it added.
This will provide 13,000 sq.feet of warehousing and 5,000 sq.feet of office space and is expected to create up to 100 new jobs by end-1998, the division's managing director, Chris Fahy told Reuters.
The intercontinental division handles both airfreight and seafreight, while the move is also expected to help further the alliance between Danzas and United Parcel Service of America Inc, Fahy added.

The Europe-wide freight handling cooperative deal, formally launched last September provides for Danzas to carry freight weighing more than 70kg and palletised shipments. UPS also provides Danzas with the option of using its worldwide network for express documents and package deliveries. Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom--Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax + 5017
